summary: Learn workforce segmentation, turnover-risk analysis and model fairness checks. Build practical talent analytics outputs in this 5-day course.
lede: Predictive analytics in HR uses workforce data and statistical methods to estimate talent outcomes without treating predictions as certainty. For HR professionals, people analysts and workforce planners, the course develops skills in checking and segmenting data, interpreting regression and decision-tree results, and validating models for fairness and uncertainty. Practice also covers turnover and skills-gap analysis, with human-capital reporting and AI risk considerations as application contexts.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work with workforce information and need to use predictive methods responsibly in talent decisions.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with HR, talent-management or workforce data is recommended. Basic comfort with workforce metrics and spreadsheet-based analysis will help; coding or programming is not required.
